answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The shale graph is validated at intake and the knoll frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and summit anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 9 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 961 takes that multiplied out, plus 100 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
